mapper.select: SELECT id, course_id, title, description, total_score, due_time, allow_late_submission, max_submission_times, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM assignments WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, course_id, title, description, total_score, due_time, allow_late_submission, max_submission_times, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM assignments WHERE id = #{id} AND course_id = #{courseId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT id, course_id, title, description, total_score, due_time, allow_late_submission, max_submission_times, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM assignments WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY due_time ASC

SELECT id, course_id, title, description, total_score, due_time, allow_late_submission, max_submission_times, status, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, is_deleted FROM assignments WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND status = 1 AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY due_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assignments ( course_id, title, description, total_score, due_time, allow_late_submission, max_submission_times, status, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{courseId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{totalScore}, #{dueTime}, #{allowLateSubmission}, #{maxSubmissionTimes}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.update: UPDATE assignments SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, total_score = #{totalScore}, due_time = #{dueTime}, allow_late_submission = #{allowLateSubmission}, max_submission_times = #{maxSubmissionTimes}, status = #{status}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
